message: I think your questions are very important, Mike. This past fall I was involved in a UNESCO Forum on open educational resources. Some of the participants from third world countries offered some postcolonial criticism of the resources made available by OCW and other OER initiatives. Those free resources, championed as important for developing countries that need textbooks and other pedagogical materials,  are constructed to support western ideas of teaching and other western values; colonialism, in effect, lives on.
